Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document 
outlines the testing procedure P1, which must performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first 
draft initiated by eng. Gabre Ali Ramadan tested by, eng. Mostafa Ibrahim,Alaa 
ELshal,. revised by quality control eng. Abdel Menem ALEmam at EDEPCo., accepted 
by general director, eng. Fawzy Sobhy Esmaile, and approved by eng. Monir 
Elwakel Head Sector of Damietta CCPS
Components
The Vibration System Consist of:
Two 
 racks (16- cards)
Approximates (17 approximates)
Two 
 racks (16- cards)
Two cards power 
 supply type3300/10: output 
 = - 23.75 + 
 .45 VDC
Two cards system 
 monitor type3300/01
Six cards dual 
 vibration type3300/15
Three cards 
 differential expansion (3300/45) one card differential expansion ( 3300/46 
 ) one card eccentricity type3300/40 - one card dual thrust type3300/20.
Approximates (17 approximates)
Sensors (17 sensors)
Safety Precautions
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety Helmet, safety shoes ...etc
A work permit
must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable
safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety Helmet, safety shoes ...etc
Unit in stand still.
Tools and Equipment
Multi-meter, Screw driver.
Contact cleaner
Work to be Carried Out
Check the power supply of the 
 system -23.75 + 0.5 VDC
If the power OK, green lamp LED 
 located in the monitor card is ON, means power supply is OK. If LED is off, 
 then change the power supply card.
Connect the DVM digital voltmeter as shown in the figure 1 and check the reading 
according to the table of MRDS
If the reading of the channel is not acceptable adjust the gap of sensor to get 
the ref value.
Repeat the steps for each bearing
Remove all jumpers
Check insulation of wire sensor.
Cleaning all cards.
Check Tighten all connections at 
 sensors, wiring, approximators
Check the power supply of the 
 system -23.75 + 0.5 VDC
If the power OK, green lamp LED 
 located in the monitor card is ON, means power supply is OK. If LED is off, 
 then change the power supply card.
Connect the DVM digital voltmeter as shown in the figure 1 and check the reading 
according to the table of MRDS
If the reading of the channel is not acceptable adjust the gap of sensor to get 
the ref value.
Repeat the steps for each bearing
Remove all jumpers
Close the work order.
